title: Reign of Solomon
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), sets the sort. The Generations dates below stay on display.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1015 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.date: 2989 1015 David dies, Solomon became sole rex
chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: Jones also prints "Solomon made pro-rex, then co-rex" in 1015. This record is the sole reign. The Generations span starts in 1015.
